mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mall_product (product_type, category_id, name, generic_name, medical_category, description, cover, price, unit, specification, manufacturer, is_otc, stock, status, create_time) VALUES ('drug', 1, #{name}, #{genericName}, #{category}, #{description}, #{cover}, #{price}, #{unit}, #{specification}, #{manufacturer}, #{isOtc}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE mall_product
name = #{name},
generic_name = #{genericName},
medical_category = #{category},
description = #{description},
price = #{price},
unit = #{unit},
specification = #{specification},
manufacturer = #{manufacturer},
cover = #{cover},
is_otc = #{isOtc},
stock = #{stock},
status = #{status},
WHERE id = #{id} AND product_type = 'drug'
mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.generic_name, p.medical_category AS category, p.description, p.price, p.unit, p.specification, p.manufacturer, p.cover, p.is_otc, p.stock, p.status, p.create_time, p.sales_count
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_cart sc WHERE sc.product_id = p.id) AS subscription_count FROM mall_product p WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.product_type = 'drug'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{drugId}
mapper.select: SELECT , sc.quantity AS subscription_count FROM mall_product p INNER JOIN shopping_cart sc ON sc.product_id = p.id WHERE sc.user_id = #{userId} AND p.product_type = 'drug' ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_cart sc WHERE sc.product_id = p.id) AS subscription_count FROM mall_product p WHERE p.product_type = 'drug' AND p.status = 1 AND (p.name LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.generic_name LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.medical_category LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY p.name ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
